body:
## Objective

Restore a clean Ruff quality gate for the committed V8-next source and tests.

## Owning authority

- v8-next pyproject.toml Ruff configuration
- Repository verification commands in v8-next/AGENTS.md and README.md

## Change class

DEFECT_FIX

## Current state / Observed defect

Running:

    uv run --project v8-next --extra dev ruff check v8-next/src v8-next/tests

fails with one I001 import-ordering error in:

    v8-next/tests/test_portfolio_benchmark.py

The import block places json after standard-library imports that Ruff expects to be alphabetized/grouped differently.

## Required end state

- Ruff passes with no diagnostics on v8-next/src and v8-next/tests.
- The fix is limited to import ordering/formatting and preserves test behavior.

## Expected file / module surface

- v8-next/tests/test_portfolio_benchmark.py
- No unrelated runtime changes

## Verification gates

    uv run --project v8-next --extra dev ruff check v8-next/src v8-next/tests
    uv run --project v8-next --extra dev pytest -q v8-next/tests/test_portfolio_benchmark.py

## Required evidence artifacts

- Clean Ruff output
- Targeted test output

## Non-goals / forbidden scope

- Do not disable I001.
- Do not alter the Ruff rule set to hide the defect.
- Do not change benchmark semantics.

## Requirements

- R1: Correct the import block.
- R2: Preserve all test behavior.
- R3: Keep the repository quality gate strict.

## Base SHA

1563d8955c6e9c47e3909037cdcdeb5961ffc800

## Evidence

PENDING
title: [DEFECT] V8-next Ruff import ordering failure blocks clean quality gate
